revision_history.title: Sleep-first absorption for Tuesday Enduro
revision_history.reason: Original recommendation used full rest after the missed social run.

decision_basis.athlete_context: The planned conversational run with Clayton's wife did not occur. Clayton elected to preserve Tuesday for Enduro work and requested a short Suito primer after three complete bike-free days, while retaining the target of sleep by 23:00 tonight.
decision_basis.freshness: Live Garmin decision sync completed at 2026-08-17T10:32+08:00 with current wellness, activity, training-status, current_state, weekly_plan and coach_packet artifacts.
decision_basis.physical_readiness: Readiness is 73 green with hard-session guidance OK. Primary sleep was 6.38 hours with score 75, wake Body Battery 81 and current Body Battery 66 at 10:26.
decision_basis.cns: CNS readiness is 87 ready with a normal ceiling when physical readiness and route consequence agree. Overnight HRV is 49 BALANCED and resting HR is 48, equal to the seven-day average.
decision_basis.load: The last seven days contain 241.4 Garmin load from two sessions and one MTB exposure. Garmin ACWR is LOW at 0.6 with balanced load focus; this permits a careful build but does not make back-to-back technical days free.
decision_basis.specificity: The planned Tuesday two-cycle Enduro Pure Quill session is the higher-value exposure. The comparable 2026-08-08 two-cycle Enduro ride cost 109.8 minutes and Garmin load 242.5, so a Monday trail ride would confound and potentially downshift Tuesday rather than prepare it.
decision_basis.weather: METMalaysia's Kuala Lumpur district forecast at decision time shows no rain Monday and Tuesday, while broader forecasting still carries localized-convection uncertainty. Weather therefore does not justify compressing the key session into Monday; Tuesday still requires a fresh warning, sky and trail check.

session.title: Early Suito primer within sleep-first Monday
session.purpose: Restore easy pedalling rhythm and contact familiarity after three bike-free days without creating muscular, aerobic, neural or sleep cost before Tuesday's Enduro session.

dose.self_gate: Start only with no illness or pain, normal symmetric legs, and no unusual sleepiness or cognitive fog. Full rest remains a successful option.
dose.phase_one: 5 minutes at 95-105 W, seated, comfortable cadence.
dose.phase_two: 20 minutes at 105-120 W and RPE 2. Begin near 105-110 W; use up to 120 W only while it remains mechanically easy and the legs feel the same or better.
dose.hard_cap: 30 minutes total, completed by 17:00. No extension to 45 minutes even when it feels easy.
dose.daylight: Use 20-30 minutes of outdoor daylight and normal easy walking before late afternoon; this is normal-life movement, not a workout.
dose.caffeine: No further caffeinated drink after 11:00. Decaffeinated coffee is acceptable if it does not disrupt the wind-down routine.
dose.nap: Do not schedule a nap. If sleepiness becomes unsafe or unmanageable, use only a 15-20-minute rescue nap ending by 13:30 and report it; accept that Tuesday still requires a fresh gate.
dose.evening: Finish dinner around 18:30-19:30, pack the Enduro and ride nutrition by 20:15, stop stimulating NYSE/Nasdaq workflow and live-market monitoring by 20:30, dim lights, begin quiet wind-down by 21:15, enter a cool dark bedroom by 22:15, and use lights out around 22:40 to target sleep by 23:00.
dose.fallback: If Clayton chooses an outdoor ride today, it replaces Tuesday's key Enduro session. Do not combine Monday MTB with the Tuesday two-cycle proof.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: A 30-minute sub-aerobic seated primer can restore pedal rhythm and reduce first-climb stiffness without creating recovery debt. The benefit comes from familiarity and circulation, not a fitness adaptation overnight; sleep opportunity remains the larger Tuesday-performance lever.
execution_rules: Do not use low ACWR as a reason to add a fourth MTB exposure or back-to-back consequence-bearing days.
Use the Marin and Elite Suito with the current saddle position unchanged. Stay seated at a comfortable 80-90 rpm; no standing, torque work, cadence drills, sprints, fit changes or gym work.
Use a strong fan. If normally fed, water to thirst is sufficient; no during-session carbohydrate or added salt is required.
Do not add hard training after 20:00; the target adaptation tonight is sleep opportunity, not fatigue.
Front-load normal hydration through the afternoon, use ordinary salt with meals, and avoid a large fluid bolus close to bed.
Eat a familiar dinner with approximately 70-100 g carbohydrate and 30-40 g protein; avoid making it unusually late, heavy, fatty, spicy or alcoholic.
If work must continue after 20:30, record the actual work-end time rather than assuming the 23:00 target was preserved.

expected_result.sleep: Lights out by approximately 22:40, sleep near 23:00, and a materially longer primary sleep opportunity than the prior 00:10-to-07:08 window.
expected_result.physical: Legs feel the same or better by minute 15 and finish fresh, with no posterior-chain or fit symptoms and no meaningful Monday training residue.
expected_result.garmin: Garmin load remains approximately 25 or lower; load is a ceiling, not a target.
expected_result.technical: Tuesday visual scanning, braking timing, line choice and coordination begin at normal speed without compensatory concentration.
expected_result.next_day: A fresh Tuesday sync and subjective gate determine whether the written two-cycle Enduro session remains available.

stop_rules: Do not convert normal energy or favorable weather into an unplanned Monday trail session while retaining Tuesday as a key day.

Stop the primer by minute 10-15 if the legs worsen or fail to feel at least equal, RPE exceeds 2, heart rate becomes disproportionate at unchanged easy power, or any knee, hamstring, calf, back, hand, saddle or cardiovascular symptom appears.

If the primer exceeds 30 minutes, becomes moderate, includes standing or torque work, or produces unusual fatigue, Tuesday loses automatic access to cycle two and must be downshifted after the fresh gate.
If unusual sleepiness, illness, pain or cognitive impairment develops, prioritize safety and recovery and report it; Tuesday is then downshifted rather than forced.
If an outdoor ride is chosen today, cancel the Tuesday quality prescription and move the matched Enduro proof to Thursday after recovery review.
